en.headline: Police investigate red-paint attack on Sau Mau Ping offices
en.dek: Officers were called at 6:40am after red paint was thrown at a joint district office used by two lawmakers in Sau Mau Ping Estate.
body: Police are investigating a criminal-damage case after red paint was thrown at a joint district office in Sau Mau Ping Estate early on Thursday.

Officers were called at about 6:40am to the ground floor of Sau Chi House, where the office used by lawmakers Tang Ka-piu and Chan Pui-leung is located. The metal gate and a notice board were splashed with red paint, and posters on the wall were also marked, according to reports of the scene.
Police said the case had been classified as criminal damage. No arrest had been announced by mid-morning, and officers were looking into the circumstances of the attack.

Tang, of the Hong Kong Federation of Trade Unions and the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong, represents Kowloon East. Chan represents the insurance functional constituency. The joint office opened in December 2022.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪議員聯合辦事處遭淋紅油 警列刑事毀壞
zh.dek: 警方今早約6時40分接報，秀茂坪邨秀緻樓地下鄧家彪與陳沛良的聯合地區辦事處被淋紅油，鐵閘及告示板均沾污。
body: 秀茂坪邨一間立法會議員聯合地區辦事處今早被人淋潑紅油，警方將案件列作刑事毀壞調查。
警方表示，今日約早上6時40分接報，秀緻樓地下的辦事處遭淋紅油。現場為工聯會及民建聯立法會議員鄧家彪與保險界議員陳沛良的聯合地區辦事處，鐵閘及告示板被潑中，牆身海報亦沾有紅油。
截至今早，警方未有公布拘捕行動，正追查事件經過。辦事處於2022年12月揭幕。鄧家彪於2025年12月立法會選舉在九龍東地方選區連任。
案件由警方跟進。當局暫時未有交代犯案動機。
